checks.label: Explicit task selection
checks.detail: The real CLI selected the accepted reading task.

checks.label: Hash-bound source and exact quotation
checks.detail: One exact quotation is retained with source hash/revision and unverified validity.

checks.label: Invalid quote rejected without ledger changes
checks.detail: The invented quotation returned exit 2; all ledger bytes are unchanged.

checks.label: Bounded arithmetic result, not scientific success
checks.detail: Means 2 and 3 yield delta 1; terminal status and claim boundary were inspected.

checks.label: Duplicate execution refused
checks.detail: A second execution returned exit 2 without a new run or ledger mutation.

checks.label: Steering requires review of stale work
checks.detail: Stale execution/decision returned exit 2; the original completed result is unchanged.

checks.label: Separate-process replay preserves completed evidence
checks.detail: Independent CLI processes replay the same state; resume does not overwrite results.

checks.label: Report retains evidence and limitations
checks.detail: The CLI report contains the quotation, provenance, original run and review requirement.

checks.label: Every real CLI exit matches its contract
checks.detail: Expected negative-path exits are recorded, not hidden or retried.

checks.label: Bounded final state
checks.detail: Three accepted tasks, one finding, one completed run; stale work remains for review.

steps.name: initialize
steps.command: python -m altauto --project project init --brief brief.md --protocol protocol.json --policy policy.json

steps.name: register-source
steps.command: python -m altauto --project project source --citation 'Synthetic archive note, paragraphs 2-3' --revision revision-1 --file source.md

steps.name: steer
steps.command: python -m altauto --project project steer --brief steered-brief.md --protocol protocol.json

steps.name: reject-stale-decision
steps.command: python -m altauto --project project decide stale-smoke --rationale 'A stale task must not gain a new decision.'

scope: Synthetic local control-plane demonstration only. Source matching is not authenticity or truth; arithmetic is not scientific validation. No provider, remote, service, GPU, speed or cost claims. Resume checks completed-result persistence, not recovery of a live or interrupted worker.
